messages:
jamie: Heads up 7: saw a small but repeatable spike in cross-region retries between eu-west and us-central around 07:05 UTC. Not as loud as last month but same symptom set.

noah: Can you paste the quick trace?

jamie: Trace shows short-lived DNS TTLs flipping for hostpool-edge-eu, clients immediately reconnecting and hitting a mix of instances. Logs show TLS alerts then 502 from upstream.

priya: Interesting. Could be the same ephemeral host replacement bug that flips symlinked certs during quick reboots. Any recent rollout touching edge hosts?

ops-bot: Auto-detect: combined-rollout:edgeconfig touched eu-west hostpool between 06:50-06:58 UTC. Alert rule: cross-region-retry-spike triggered.

ola: Assigning owners: I'll take lead on hostpool config audit (owner: ola). @noah take a look at DNS/edge control-plane chatter. @kevin check cert persistence on reboot path.

noah: Running `api.calls("controlplane.hostpool.update AND region:eu-west").window(15m)` now.

kevin: I'll run a quick ssh into a recently replaced host to validate cert files and symlinks.

jamie: For mitigations, can we throttle reconnection attempts at the proxy layer while we investigate? We keep seeing cascading retries.

priya: Agreed. Suggest adding simple client-side backoff rule in proxy config: `backoff.initial=200ms, multiplier=2, max=5s, attempts=4` for eu-west route. Minimal change and reversible.

ops-bot: Created follow-up ticket: PM-INC-2204-EUHOSTPOOL. Linked: https://pm/redwood/PM-INC-2204-EUHOSTPOOL

ola: Filing action items in that ticket: ACTION-1 audit deploy jobs touching /etc/ssl on edge hosts (owner: kevin) due 24h, ACTION-2 DNS TTL investigation (owner: noah) due 48h, ACTION-3 add proxy backoff and canary (owner: priya) due EOD.

kevin: Quick update: on host h-eu-212 I see `/etc/ssl/current` is a broken symlink after the kube-provisioner restarted. The packaged certs exist in `/opt/certs` but symlink points to `/etc/ssl/old`.

noah: My query shows the control-plane pushed a hostpool shrink at 06:53 then a rapid scale up at 06:56. That matches the TTL churn window. Creating a small dashboard.

priya: I'm going to push the backoff to canary path now for eu-west only. Will monitor retries and tail TLS alerts. Config snippet I'm using: ```yaml
route: /eu-west
  retry:
    strategy: exponential
    initial_ms: 200
    multiplier: 2
    max_ms: 5000
    attempts: 4
```

jamie: Please also enable a short suppression on paging for the first 10m so ops isn't paged for the transient noise while canary runs.

ops-bot: Canary started by priya. Canary ID: cny-208123-02. Window: 15m. Suppression applied: 10m.

kevin: I can repro the symlink flip locally with the provisioner step that unpacks certs and rebinds service user. Looks like race when provisioning runs concurrently with kubelet restart. Patch idea: write certs atomically to new dir then swap symlink with `ln -nfs` in one op. Also add systemd ordering so service starts after symlink set.

noah: Dashboard shows retries down ~65% in canary window, TLS alerts reduced. Link: https://dashboards/redwood/canary/cny-208123-02

ola: Good signal. I'll convert ACTION-1 to a code change and request infra review. ACTION-2: still verifying if TTL policy data plane is misconfigured or a control plane flurry.

priya: Canary looks healthy. Planning staged rollout across 4 hostpools over next 2 hours if no regression.

jamie: For the postmortem follow-up doc, include: symptom timeline, canary graphs, exact deploy job IDs, repro steps for symlink flip, and owner commitments + dates. Make sure the recurring-monitor rule is set: `sum(tls.handshake_failure) by region` with 3x spike in 24h triggers elevated review.

ops-bot: Created recurring-monitor alert: RMON-2204-TLS-REGION. Owner: noah.

kevin: Opening PR with atomic symlink change and systemd ordering: https://git/redwood/infra/pull/1898. Adding unit test that simulates concurrent provisioner + kubelet restart.

noah: Adding DNS TTL dashboard annotation to the ticket and will surface any related zone config changes in last 30 days.

ola: Summarizing timeline in PM-INC-2204-EUHOSTPOOL and assigning reviewers. ACTION-1 -> kevin (PR due 24h), ACTION-2 -> noah (investigation due 48h), ACTION-3 -> priya (canary + rollout EOD). If any action slips, escalate to SRE lead.

jamie: Thanks all. Quick sync in 1h to confirm rollout progress. :thumbsup:
